IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 48(11):1342-1347. Reference impls: NeuroKit2 hrv_nonlinear (Makowski et al. 2021) + independent numpy (Harris et al. 2020). Data: Fantasia Database, PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes SD1/SD2/ratio with an independent numpy analytical closed-form (bit-exact) and cross-checks NeuroKit2 hrv_nonlinear (SD1 bit-for-bit; NeuroKit2's SD2 = paired projection, reproduced bit-for-bit by an independent numpy paired projection), and reports SD1/SD2/ratio, the numpy agreement, both NeuroKit2 checks, the SD2 convention gap, and the RR count
